method: Reproduced reviewer-2 mutation escapes: delete causeModel, reverse precedence, delete crossAxisInvariants, desync commandKind — all previously escaped.
Compared reviewer-1 blind axes (22 cases) and reviewer-2 full 43-case reauthor against binding goldens.
Independently confirmed A1-D9-V15-03 rejection (X9) is correct.
Repaired binding artifact and extended check-d9.py with D14–D16 + concurrentConditionGoldens + 5 new mutations.

findingDispositions.evidence: Golden user-interrupt-post-finalization-commit scenario originally stated only non-reclassification; axes asserted pass/satisfied/committed/success without human entailment. finalizationTransitions table covers all classes but does not make that sentence self-sufficient.
findingDispositions.reasoning: Independent re-derivation cannot recover success without prose naming the pre-signal settlement. This is the v1.5 same-author trap class.
findingDispositions.requiredChange: Rewrite scenario to state successful pass was already settled; retain finalizationTransitions; mutation flips a transition.
findingDispositions.whatWouldChangeMyMind: Evidence that axes for this case are mechanically derived from words already in the original sentence alone.

findingDispositions.evidence: ledger-busy-timeout-exceeded and machine-output-serialization-failed used commandKind=any with admission=admitted and lifecycle=not-applicable without locating the fault relative to Run publication.
findingDispositions.reasoning: A single concrete lifecycle tuple cannot be universal across pre-Run and post-commit phases. Implementers would lose Run identity or invent a false no-Run claim.
findingDispositions.requiredChange: Define host-finalization-only projectionScope; state preservesSettledRun; rewrite scenarios.
findingDispositions.verification: Both goldens carry projectionScope=host-finalization-only and hostFinalizationProjection; checker enforces the flags.
findingDispositions.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A binding proof that lifecycle/durability on these goldens never describe Run state by construction in all host code paths.

findingDispositions.evidence: Eight scenarios asserted lifecycle/Coverage/durability values not present in human prose (reviewer-2 list).
findingDispositions.reasoning: Same-author axis/derivation consistency is not independent evidence. Prose must state load-bearing axes.
findingDispositions.requiredChange: Rewrite each listed scenario so every load-bearing axis is human-stated.
findingDispositions.verification: All eight scenarios rewritten with explicit lifecycle/coverage/durability/fault framing.
findingDispositions.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A mechanical derivation rule from original prose alone that recovers the axes without case-specific assumptions.

findingDispositions.evidence: causeModel.precedence claimed fault>rejection>deficiency but scenarioAxes forbids multi-family input; deleting causeModel or reversing precedence left check-d9 green.
findingDispositions.reasoning: Advertised executable precedence was prose-only. Builders could implement the opposite order.
findingDispositions.requiredChange: concurrentConditionReducer + concurrentConditionGoldens; checker D14/D15; mutations on delete/reverse.
findingDispositions.verification: 5 concurrent goldens; delete causeModel and reverse precedence mutations rejected.

findingDispositions.evidence: crossAxisInvariants could be deleted; top-level commandKind could desync from scenarioAxes.commandKind without findings.
findingDispositions.reasoning: Declared contract fields must be load-bearing or they become local forms for global claims.
findingDispositions.requiredChange: D12 declaration presence; D16 commandKind equality; mutations.

findingDispositions.evidence: Reviewer-1 CONFIRM_ACCEPT_X9; reviewer-2 CONFIRM_AGENT_3_REJECTION. serve-graceful-signal-stop observes SIGINT/SIGTERM before shutdown; interruption=none would encode a falsehood.
findingDispositions.reasoning: Success remains correct because the signal is a stop trigger, not the terminating cause. X9 is the order-independent rule.
findingDispositions.verification: X9 still enforced; serve interrupted mutation rejected.
findingDispositions.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A serve model where graceful stop is not a signal-before-finalization event.

findingDispositions.evidence: Reviewer-1: 22/22 class match; 6 axis disagreements resolved ARTIFACT_CORRECT. Reviewer-2: 42/43 concrete class match; post-finalization was the real prose defect.
findingDispositions.reasoning: Blind reauthor largely corroborates class derivation; residual defects were prose/precedence/checker gaps, not a wrong class table.
findingDispositions.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A new independent blind sample finding a class mismatch after prose repairs.

sealedPropertiesCovered: D9 termination is a single host-owned projection
fault > rejection > deficiency cause precedence (now executable)
post-finalization signals do not reclassify settled termination
finite, query, mutation, serve, rejection, deficiency, and fault termination families
knownLimitations: Goldens and derive_class still share maintenance ownership; independent blind reauthor remains the only check against co-consistency traps for NEW goldens.
commandKind=any host-finalization projection relies on implementers honouring preservesSettledRun outside the pure axes tuple.

sealRecommendation.note: Load-bearing R2 findings repaired and mutation-guarded. Residual risk is process (future goldens need blind reauthor), not an open architecture fork.
